summary.one_liner: This reference manual (revision r3p7) documents the Arm Neoverse CMN-700 Coherent Mesh Network, but the page text provided covers only its release history, legal notices and feedback channels, not the technical content.
takeaways: The manual is the reference for Arm Neoverse CMN-700 Coherent Mesh Network, revision r3p7.
The listing says it defines the mesh, the home nodes holding the system cache and snoop filter, and the gateways joining sockets or CXL; the page text provided does not confirm these details.
The release table shows the document went from r0p0 LAC (2020) to r3p7 EAC (February 2026), with the current issue marked Final and Non-Confidential.
Feedback on the product goes through a support ticket, and feedback on the document goes through a survey, per the page.
summary.summary: The page is the front matter of the Arm Neoverse CMN-700 Coherent Mesh Network Technical Reference Manual, revision r3p7. The text provided includes a release history table from the first r0p0 LAC release in December 2020 through issue 0307-08 for r3p7 in February 2026, plus legal notices, confidentiality status, product status, and feedback and inclusive-language sections. It does not include the technical chapters on the mesh, home nodes, or gateways that the listing describes, so those topics could not be verified from this text. The page is best treated as a pointer to the full manual rather than a source of technical detail.
